questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (9 + 2i) + (−4 + 5i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: 9 − 4 = 5. Add imaginary parts: 2i + 5i = 7i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (4 − 2i) + (5 + 6i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: 4 + 5 = 9. Add imaginary parts: −2i + 6i = 4i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (−3 + 5i) + (9 − 1i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: −3 + 9 = 6. Add imaginary parts: 5i − 1i = 4i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the difference (6 + 2i) − (1 + 7i)?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: 6 − (1) = 5. Subtract imaginary parts: 2i − (7i) = −5i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (8 − 4i) + (−2 + 3i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: 8 − 2 = 6. Add imaginary parts: −4i + 3i = −1i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the difference (5 + 5i) − (3 − 2i)?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: 5 − (3) = 2. Subtract imaginary parts: 5i − (−2i) = 7i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (−6 + 1i) + (−4 + 8i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: −6 − 4 = −10. Add imaginary parts: 1i + 8i = 9i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the difference (10 − 3i) − (7 + 5i)?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: 10 − (7) = 3. Subtract imaginary parts: −3i − (5i) = −8i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the sum (2 + 9i) + (−5 − 6i)?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: 2 − 5 = −3. Add imaginary parts: 9i − 6i = 3i.

questions.question: For i = √−1, what is the difference (−1 − 7i) − (4 + 2i)?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: −1 − (4) = −5. Subtract imaginary parts: −7i − (2i) = −9i.
